messages:
mona_release: Propose lifting soft-pin for runtime 2.18 on canary (ap-southeast) at 02:00 UTC to validate improved kernel selection and quant-v5. Will rely on deploybot preflight.

raj_runtime: Note: runtime 2.18 adds a GC timing tweak that may change memory pressure patterns. We saw increased eviction in internal perf tests.

elyse_platform: I'll stage 2.18 to hosted-staging at 01:00 UTC and run quick smoke. Please avoid auto-unpin if any WARN.

chris_sre: Gating thresholds: 99p latency < +7%, eviction delta < 6%, error-rate < 0.1%. Any sdk-compat FAIL is block. I'll be on watch.

deploybot: Preflight scheduled 01:40 UTC. Will report model, runtime, sdk, infra checks.

mona_release: Also drafting release note blurb; include note that SDK >=3.6 recommended.

raj_runtime: Compatibility note: SDK 3.6 changes the streaming framing; we added a shim-unaware fallback but recommend clients upgrade.

deploybot: Preflight result: model: OK; runtime: WARN(evictions:+9%); sdk: OK; infra: OK. Aggregated: WARN.

mona_release: Given WARN on evictions and raj's note, manual hold. Raj, can we push a tiny kvcache tweak to reduce evictions?

raj_runtime: I can prepare a small config tweak (ttl bump) and cut a PR. If merged and staged by 01:50 UTC we can rerun preflight.

elyse_platform: Adding short hold to prevent accidental unpin:
/deploybot pin add --scope canary --target runtime:2.18 --until 2026-03-25T03:30:00Z --reason "hold for kvcache tweak & smoke"

deploybot: Hold applied. Re-run preflight scheduled at 02:00 UTC after patch merge.

raj_runtime: PR merged and promoted to staging.

deploybot: Re-run preflight: model: OK; runtime: OK(evictions:+2%); sdk: OK; infra: OK. Aggregated: OK.

mona_release: Proceeding with unpin at 02:00 UTC, with 20m observation window. If metrics breach, rollback to 2.17 on canary only.

chris_sre: Watching. No OOMs; latency +3%; evictions within gate.

deploybot: Soft-pin removed for runtime:2.18 on canary at 02:00 UTC. Observation until 02:20 UTC.

mona_release: After observation looks good. Will prepare staged rollout tomorrow. Thanks team :rocket:
